answer: Gate paid work behind a jade-standard trial voyage. A newcomer must finish a supervised 14-day voyage of ten varied jobs, each reviewed by two independent auditors, and lock an 850 POA trial bond for the full period. If auditors find copied output, a shared payout route, or identical timing across identities, the bond is burned and the identity is barred for two years, so one hundred fakes risk 85,000 POA. Any fable about overnight success fades fast here; real standing is earned one verified job at a time, like jade polished slowly rather than painted.
